description: Search tracked data center projects. Filter by free-text query (name, developer, tenant, city), US state code, status, developer, or minimum MW. Returns up to 50 rows sorted by capacity.

developer.description: Developer or operator name, partial match, e.g. "Meta" or "QTS"

limit.description: How many projects to return, 1 to 50 (default 20)

query.description: Free text matched against name, developer, tenant and city, e.g. "Stargate" or "Abilene"

state.description: Two-letter US state code, e.g. TX

status.description: Campus status. Use under_construction for what is being built (operational campuses with expanding: true are also adding buildings)

name: search_projects
title: Search data center projects
